The '''Nalyd system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nalyd]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nalydian]]s.
